name: The Everyday Edit
direction: Warm modern care: apricot, burgundy and soft olive; an arched sunlit portrait, large sans typography with italic serif accents, open treatment rows and a clear first-visit progression.
intent: Make a personal service easy to understand: what is treated, who provides care, what the first visit involves, and which practical details remain to be confirmed.

sources_reviewed.used_for: A separate, clearly explained new-client consultation path; no borrowed prices, policies or additional services.
Specific treatment-area descriptions with a nearby consultation path; Evergreen scope kept separate.
Premium visual restraint, natural imagery and editorial pacing.
Approachable service language and repeated, clear next-step navigation.
Hair/skin color independence, fine-probe process and individual multi-visit planning.
California consumer guidance, electrology definition, expected redness and medical escalation for severe symptoms.
Treatment sensation, series of visits, consultation and aftercare context.

business_facts: User-provided practice details and existing approved website: American Canyon; Nav, California-licensed electrologist; bachelor’s in Microbiology, UC Davis; completed professional training at California Electrology Academy, Corona; face and selected body areas; no intimate-area services.

image.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: portrait photograph for a premium electrolysis website, paired beside headline on a warm apricot background. Create one beautiful natural-light portrait of an adult woman in her early 40s with warm medium-brown skin, dark wavy hair loosely tucked back, wearing a simple ivory linen boat-neck blouse. She has a relaxed, candid soft smile, looking slightly past the camera; authentic pores and fine facial lines, minimal makeup. Waist-up or shoulders-to-crown composition, face centered with ample warm cream backdrop and some soft sunlight from the side. Beautiful long afternoon shadows across a textured plaster background. Intimate medium-format photography, sophisticated California sensibility, gentle film grain, muted honey and cream palette, not glossy advertising. Vertical 4:5 composition. No text, no logos, no graphics, no equipment, no before/after comparison.

preservation: The export manifest hashes original homepage and Designs 02–04 source plus published HTML/assets. Static export retains their snapshots and original content-hashed CSS. New page uses its own CSS module; earlier app pages and globals are unchanged. Original published GitHub CSS used index-Da5-CrcS.css; old HTML snapshots were synchronized to that live filename after verifying all text/tags otherwise identical. Every earlier image and font was checked against the live site and matched.
